Package com.example.releasethekraken.model

Class WaitingListRepository

java.lang.Object
com.example.releasethekraken.model.WaitingListRepository
public class WaitingListRepository extends Object
repository responsible for saving and retrieving waiting list entries from Firestore this class belongs to the model layer and contains no UI logic it communicates with Firebase to manage waiting list data for events
